method: Combine besan & yogurt in a bowl. gradually add water and whisk until achieving a lump-free, smooth mixture.

In a kadhai over low heat, add ghee then mustard seeds and let them crackle. Follow by adding cumin seeds, cinnamon stick, cloves, curry leaves, fenugreek seeds, hing along with finely chopped chilli and ginger, sauté for about a minute, being careful not to burn the spices
Pour in the prepared yogurt-water mixture and stir well to combine
Bring the mixture to a gentle boil over medium heat then reduce the heat and simmer for 5 to 7 minutes, ensuring the besan loses its raw taste

Serve Gujarati kadhi hot or warm alongside steamed rice ideally accompanied by a vegetable side dish, pickle, and salad.
Consume any leftover kadhi on the next day max | store in the fridge

Nutrition: 
C: 18 | F: 11 | P: 10
Calories: 227 per serve
Serves 3

Ingredients 
1 1/2 cups dahi ( around 500 grams ), i like using packet dahi for this recipe 
2 1/2 cups water
4 tbsp besan 

temper 
1/2 tbsp ghee/ oil 
1 inch cinnamon
2 cloves
8-10 curry leaves
pinch of hing
1 inch ginger + 2 green chillies, finely chopped
2 dry red chillies, broken and de seed ( optional )
1/2 tsp cumin
1/4 tsp methi seeds
1/2 - 1 tbsp jaggery powder, adjust to taste
salt, to taste

Method 
combine besan & yogurt in a bowl. gradually add water and whisk until achieving a lump-free, smooth mixture.
in a kadhai over low heat, add ghee then mustard seeds and let them crackle. Follow by adding cumin seeds, cinnamon stick, cloves, curry leaves, fenugreek seeds, hing along with finely chopped chilli and ginger, sauté for about a minute, being careful not to burn the spices
pour in the prepared yogurt-water mixture and stir well to combine
bring the mixture to a gentle boil over medium heat then reduce the heat and simmer for 5 to 7 minutes, ensuring the besan loses its raw taste
while its simmering, stir frequently to prevent lumps from forming, add in salt ( if needed ) and jaggery powder 
once ready, garnish with chopped coriander. 

serve Gujarati kadhi hot or warm alongside steamed rice  ideally accompanied by a vegetable side dish, pickle, and salad.
consume any leftover kadhi on the next day max | store in the fridge
